package handler

import "testing"

func TestScenarioVisitorPermissions(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	f.refuse(t, 1, f.command(t, 1, "plant"))
	f.do(t, 0, "plant")
	f.refuse(t, 1, f.command(t, 1, "harvest"))
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "help"))
	f.do(t, 1, "help")
	f.refuse(t, 1, f.command(t, 1, "help"))
}
func TestScenarioOfflineHarvestOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	f.do(t, 0, "plant")
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "harvest"))
	f.now.Add(86400000)
	c := f.command(t, 0, "harvest")
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		if _, err := f.send(0, c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.players[0].Dao().GetCoins() != 5 || f.state(t).Harvests != 1 {
		t.Fatal("offline reward duplicated")
	}
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "harvest"))
}
func TestScenarioHelpChangesDeadlineOnlyOnce(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	f.do(t, 0, "plant")
	c := f.command(t, 1, "help")
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		if _, err := f.send(1, c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if f.state(t).ReadyAt != f.now.Load()+50000 {
		t.Fatal("help duplicated")
	}
	f.now.Add(50000)
	f.do(t, 0, "harvest")
}
func TestScenarioHarvestRollback(t *testing.T) {
	f := newScenario(t)
	f.do(t, 0, "plant")
	f.now.Add(60000)
	f.committer.reject.Store(true)
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "harvest"))
	f.committer.reject.Store(false)
	f.do(t, 0, "harvest")
	if f.players[0].Dao().GetCoins() != 5 {
		t.Fatal("harvest lost")
	}
}
